run_realtime_transcription_cli: run the vLLM realtime speech transcription Gradio demo with host and port arguments
create_gradio_microphone_demo: create a Gradio demo for real-time speech transcription using the vLLM Realtime API
build_websocket_audio_stream: build a WebSocket connection that streams audio chunks and receives transcription deltas
process_audio_numpy: process incoming numpy audio data by converting to mono, normalizing, resampling, and base64 encoding
test_realtime_transcription: test the realtime transcription service by starting recording, streaming audio, and verifying output
